name: ScholarBrief — API on RapidAPI
description:
Build a citation brief for a batch of papers in one call: ScholarBrief takes DOIs and returns each work's Crossref citation footprint plus its Wikipedia pageview slice, so literature reviews and research dashboards get consistent numbers without gluing two APIs together.

What you get:
- Crossref record per DOI: citation count, authors (first 8), venue, year and references count
- Wikipedia pageview totals for the matched article over your window — a public-attention slice, not an altmetric score
- Confident-match rules: a brief is only returned when the Crossref match is solid; otherwise you get the best rejected candidate and its score, never a silent wrong match
- Batch briefs in one response with a summary

Key endpoints:
- POST /brief/batch — brief up to 25 DOIs in one call
- POST /brief/single — brief one DOI
- GET /health — service status

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
